feedback.jei.circuit_chain.note2: Cheapest route: printed board, coherer, tin.
gui.feedback.solder.title: Soldering
feedback.jei.soldering.note: Hand iron: drag along the pad row, pace sets the joint. Or reflow oven. Etched traces lift at their wire's limit.
feedback.jei.info.coherer: Open until a nearby spark welds its grains into a wire; it stays welded until you tap it with an empty hand. A spark is an arc from a breaker or relay opening under load, or an electrostatic generator.
feedback.jei.info.whisker: A wire on a crystal. Right-click with a crystal to seat it, then step the whisker round its 8 spots with an empty hand to find one that works. On a spark it closes the line for half a second.
feedback.jei.info.relay: Put it against an electromagnet. A small current in the magnet's line closes the relay's own line. It wears when it switches under load.
feedback.jei.info.component_tester: Right-click a placed whisker, coherer or relay to read how it responds. With a trace board in the other hand, right-click in the air to read the board.
feedback.jei.info.oscilloscope: Put it against a cable and against a phosphor screen. It only reads: right-click for the last 16 samples. A signal pegged at the top is exact and wrong.
feedback.jei.info.phosphor_screen: Set it on a firebox, heat it, then right-click with an empty hand to seal it. The hotter the seal, the better the vacuum. Pair it with an oscilloscope. Holding it at full brightness burns it in.
feedback.jei.info.reflow_oven: Set it on a firebox. Right-click with pasted boards to load up to four, empty hand to take them out: joints are set from the hottest they got and how long they sat above the solder's melting point.
feedback.jei.info.soldering_iron: Right-click a fire to heat it. Right-click with a pasted board in the other hand to open the soldering screen, then hold the button and drag the tip along the pad row. Pace is the skill: too fast and a pad stays dull (cold), too slow and it scorches and the trace lifts, a shaky hand bridges. The iron cools as it works, so later pads want a slower pace. Reheat and come back to start again.
feedback.jei.info.diamond_grinding_wheel: A grinding wheel with diamond grit: hard enough to cut quartz and amethyst into crystal plates, and to grind a plate one cut finer. Sits on a shaft line like the stone wheel.
feedback.jei.info.mass_probe: Hang it in an electrolytic cell to read how much metal has plated onto it. Its cut is the cut of the crystal plate it was made from: fine sees detail and not far, coarse sees far and coarsely.
feedback.jei.info.trace_board: Make a substrate on a grinding wheel, lay traces (etched or printed) in a crafting grid, mount parts, paste with solder, then solder it with an iron or reflow oven.
feedback.jei.info.circuit: A soldered board with parts on it. It carries elements, speed, noise and joints, read with a component tester. A cold joint gives a noisy circuit; lifted traces give a dead one.
feedback.jei.info.galena: A rectifying crystal. Seat it in a cat's whisker detector, or mount it on a trace board as a switching part.
feedback.jei.info.pyrite: A rectifying crystal, poorer than galena. Seat it in a cat's whisker detector, or mount it on a trace board as a switching part.
feedback.jei.info.electrolytic_cell: Fill it with water and wire it to a supply. Hang a metal on top: it dissolves into the water, and the current plates metal back out onto the cathode. The voltage decides which metal plates; the current decides how fast. Hang a metal piece on a side and it takes the coat instead. Nothing stops when the anode is gone.
feedback.jei.info.gloves: Worn in the hands slot, a glove of leather or cloth keeps warm work and a weakly live bare wire off the skin, as far as the material stands it: enough to ladle from a lit furnace. A metacarpal plate on the back of the hand punches harder, guards you and lets a bare hand parry, but a heavy one slows your swing; it keeps no heat off.
feedback.jei.info.hand_hammer: Put it in a crafting grid with one workpiece: each craft is one blow, and the result slot shows what that blow would make. Sneak-scroll chooses how hard you swing. A blow that cannot land -- metal too hard or too cold -- offers no craft.
feedback.jei.info.tongs: Two rods of one metal and a grip, in any arrangement in a crafting grid. Held in one hand, they let you carry hot work in the other. How hot depends on what the grip and the arms are made of.
message.feedback.blueprint_table.cannot_: Cannot print: this type is not put together that way.
modular.feedback.desc.part.bow_limbs: The arms of a bow: three lengths of stock bent to a draw. Their strength sets how hard it shoots.
modular.feedback.desc.part.shield_face: The broad face of a shield. Its material sets what blow it can take; its shape sets what the shield is.
modular.feedback.desc.part.receiver: The body of a gun: it holds the chamber, the action and the stock. Its shape sets what kind of gun it is.
modular.feedback.desc.part.gun_barrel: The tube the bullet runs down. A longer barrel gives a faster, truer shot; its bore sets the calibre it takes.
modular.feedback.desc.part.slide: A sliding block that cycles the action. It lets a gun load itself from the recoil or the gas.
modular.feedback.desc.part.bolt: Seals the breech and works the action by hand, by lever, by pump, by break or by itself.
modular.feedback.desc.part.trigger_group: The trigger and the sear it releases. It is what makes the gun fire when you ask.
modular.feedback.desc.part.cylinder: A drum of chambers that turns a round into line at each pull. A revolver's whole feed.
modular.feedback.desc.part.magazine_tube: A tube of rounds under or beside the barrel. It feeds the action one round at a time.
modular.feedback.desc.part.belt_feed: Pulls a belt of rounds through the action. It feeds a machine gun as long as the belt lasts.
modular.feedback.desc.part.sight: Shows where the shot will go. A better sight tightens the aim, never the gun.
modular.feedback.desc.part.suppressor: Slows the muzzle gas to quiet the shot. It holds heat in the can and gets hot.
modular.feedback.desc.part.muzzle_brake: Vents gas sideways at the muzzle to cut kick. The blast at the sides grows louder.
modular.feedback.desc.part.thermal_sleev: A sleeve shrunk onto the barrel. Loose cold, it closes on the barrel as it heats and tightens the group; left to get too hot it grips the bore and squeezes the chamber.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.thermal_fit: Loose when cold, tightest at a warm barrel, binding when it runs too hot.
modular.feedback.desc.part.sculk_jacket: A jacket that stores the barrel's vibration. Cold, it quiets the barrel and tightens the group; once the barrel is hot the stored vibration spoils and the group opens wider than bare.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.sculk_jacket: Tight while the barrel is cold, worse than bare once it is hot.
modular.feedback.desc.part.resonance_wei: A weight threaded on the barrel. Where it sits tunes the barrel to one muzzle speed: a round near it shoots tight, a round far from it shoots worse than a bare barrel.
modular.feedback.desc.part.main_spring: A wound spring that throws the round. Its stored work goes as the stress its metal bears, squared, so only a good spring steel is worth fitting; every coil of stock stores more and takes longer to recock. No gas, no powder: it fires a round with nothing in the case.
modular.feedback.desc.part.steam_chest: A vessel of rolled plate that holds the steam a steam gun throws its round with. Right click a boiler with the gun to fill it. The chest's metal sets the pressure it holds; a chest weaker than the boiler's relief line hurts the one holding the gun. Each shot lets out some steam, and the rest condenses away while the gun is carried.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.large_ches: Ten shots of steam, at the same pressure, for twice the plate and more weight.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.light_spri: One coil of stock. Light to recock.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.heavy_spri: Two coils of stock: twice the stored work, and twice the time to recock.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.resonance: Tuned to one muzzle speed; the further the round is from it, the wider the group.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.thread_bre: Tuned for slow rounds, about 250 m/s.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.thread_mid: Tuned for a middling round, about 450 m/s.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.thread_muz: Tuned for fast rounds, about 800 m/s.
modular.feedback.desc.part.counterweight: A dense mass that runs against the bolt and cancels kick. It slows the cycle, and a worn bore cuts its stroke short so it slaps the receiver instead.
modular.feedback.desc.part.bipod: Folding legs under the barrel. Crouched and still, they take the kick and tighten the group.
modular.feedback.desc.part.bayonet: A lug and blade under the barrel, for a thrust with the gun in hand.
modular.feedback.desc.part.selector_swit: A switch on the trigger group that lets the gun fire in bursts or automatic.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.counterweigh: Cancels kick and slows the cycle; wear makes it slap.
modular.feedback.desc.part.eddy_sleeve: A conductive sleeve at the muzzle. A bullet of the right metal drags on it as it leaves and slows.
modular.feedback.desc.part.relief_vent: A port in the receiver that bleeds gas when pressure climbs too high, sparing the gun some overpressure.
modular.feedback.desc.part.barrel_shroud: A jacket round the barrel. It sheds heat to the air so the gun cools sooner.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.shortbow: Like bow limbs, but short: two lengths of stock. Draws in well under a second and shoots light, so a quick shot flies slower and hits softer.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.longbow: Like bow limbs, but tall: four lengths of stock. Shoots fast and hard, but takes half as long again to draw and slows you while it is drawn.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.recurve: Like bow limbs, but forged with a curl in each tip in a run of taps and heavy blows. A full draw hits harder and passes through a mob; a part draw is only an ordinary bow, and the draw is a little slower.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.hunting: Like bow limbs, but forged in a steady run of taps and left light. The shot is silent and an arrow to an animal's head hits much harder; it flies slower and hits softer on anything else.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.arbalest: Like a crossbow prod, but huge: four lengths of stock. Each bolt hits far harder and passes through two mobs, but loading takes more than twice as long and slows you.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.pistol: Like a crossbow prod, but a single length of stock. Loads in under half the time; the bolt is slow and light, so it is a short-range weapon.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.repeater: Like a crossbow prod, but forged with a rack in a run of light taps and heavies. One load takes three bolts from the quiver and one shot looses them all, scattered; each hits a little softer and loading takes longer.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.buckler: Like a shield face, but small: four lengths of stock. On the parry key it parries a blow whole and throws the attacker back; raised for plain blocking it guards a narrow arc and holds little.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.kite: Like a shield face, but long and tapered: five lengths of stock. A projectile it stops is sent back where you look and hardly wears it; a melee blow is held to less.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.tower: Like a shield face, but a wall: nine lengths of stock. Guards every angle and holds much more, but slows you when raised, wears faster, and a sprinting use bashes mobs away instead of raising it.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.snap_shot: The draw takes %1$s%% of the time, and the arrow leaves at %2$s%% of the speed (and so of the damage).
modular.feedback.desc.trait.heavy_draw: The draw takes %1$s%% of the time and the arrow leaves at %2$s%% of the speed, which is damage as well as range. While drawn it slows you by %3$s%%.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.heavy_bolt: Loading takes %1$s%% of the time. Each bolt does %2$s%% damage and passes through %3$s mobs. While loading it slows you by %4$s%%.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.snap_bolt: Loading takes %1$s%% of the time. The bolt leaves at %2$s%% of the speed and does %3$s%% damage.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.recurve: A full draw shoots an arrow that does %1$s%% more damage and passes through %2$s mob. A part draw gets neither. The draw takes %3$s%% of the time.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.stalker: The shot makes no sound. An arrow to an animal's head does x%1$s damage. The arrow leaves at %2$s%% of the speed and the draw takes %3$s%% of the time.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.repeater: Loading takes %1$s bolts from the quiver at once and one shot looses them all, scattered (x%4$s the usual spread). Loading takes %2$s%% of the time and each bolt does %3$s%% damage.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.parry: This shield parries on the parry key: a blow that lands in the %1$s s window is stopped whole and throws the attacker back. Raised for plain blocking it guards only a %2$s degree arc ahead and holds %3$s%% of what its face could.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.deflect: This shield deflects on the parry key: a projectile that lands in the window is sent back the way you look at %1$s%% of its speed. It does not parry a melee blow, and raised for plain blocking holds one to %2$s%% of what the face could.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.bulwark: Guards every angle once raised and holds %1$s%% of what a plain face could, but slows you %2$s%% and wears %3$s%% as fast. Use it while sprinting to bash instead: hostiles within %4$s blocks ahead take %5$s damage and are thrown back, at a cost of wear, hunger, your sprint and %6$s s before the shield can be raised again.
modular.feedback.role.box_feed.tip: A box of rounds that feeds the action: reloads in one piece, and holds more rounds than a tube.
modular.feedback.role.thermal_sleeve.tip: A sleeve round the barrel that tightens as it heats: a cold barrel throws wider, a warm one groups tighter, a hot one binds.
modular.feedback.role.counterweight.tip: A weight in the buffer: less kick, a slower cycle, and a slap of kick when the action returns.
modular.feedback.role.bipod.tip: Folding legs under the gun: much less kick and spread when braced.
modular.feedback.role.bayonet.tip: A blade on the barrel lug: lets you stab with the gun in hand.
modular.feedback.role.selector.tip: A switch on the receiver that gives select fire.
modular.feedback.role.sculk_jacket.tip: A sculk-lined jacket on the barrel: tighter spread while cold, but it spoils and throws wide when it goes off.
modular.feedback.role.resonance.tip: A weight threaded on the barrel that tunes its ring: further toward the muzzle tunes a slower shot.
modular.feedback.role.main_spring.tip: The spring that drives the action: a heavier one has more coils.
modular.feedback.role.steam_chest.tip: A chest that holds steam for a steam gun: a larger one holds more.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.handgun: Held in one hand, no stock: nothing braces it, so kick and spread are the wrist's. Pistol, revolver, derringer and machine pistol are all this.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.rifle: A shoulder stock takes the kick into the body and a long barrel steadies the bullet. Carbine, assault rifle and sniper rifle are rifles told by barrel, action and sight.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.shotgun: A smoothbore made to throw shot: a pattern that spreads with distance. The only gun that takes a shell.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.machine_gu: A heavy frame built for sustained fire from an open bolt. Its trouble is heat, not aim.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.self_loadi: Cycles off the shot, one round a pull.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.automatic: Cycles off the shot and keeps firing while the trigger is held; select fire.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.bolt: A manual bolt: slow between shots, locked tight into the barrel.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.lever: Worked by a lever under the grip; a hammer strikes the primer.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.pump: Worked by a sliding forend; a hammer strikes the primer.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.break: The barrels hinge open to load; a hammer strikes the primer.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.revolver: Rounds wait in a turning cylinder; with a hammer it can be fanned.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.belt: The rounds are a chain: a long reload, and a belt as long as the chain.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.reflex: Aims with a modest zoom, quickly raised.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.scope: A lot of zoom, slowly raised.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.hammer: A hammer strikes the primer. It lets a cylinder be fitted and fanned.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.manual_cycle: The next round is brought up by the shooter: this much longer between shots, in the cycle figure.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.select_fire: Semi, burst or full automatic, switched in hand.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.double_barre: Two barrels side by side. Sneaking while you pull fires both at once for one recoil.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.closed_bolt: A round sits in the hot chamber: above its charge's ignition temperature it cooks off on its own.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.blowback: Only the bolt's mass holds the breech shut. A round that makes more than %1$s Pu kicks harder in proportion and wears the bore x%2$s faster by the excess.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.bolt_lockup: Lugs lock the bolt into the barrel: the chamber is rated %1$s%% stronger for the same steel, and the group tighter by %2$s%%.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.gas_operated: The gas works the action: a cycle %1$s%% quicker that pressure does not hurt, paid in %2$s%% more heat and %3$s Mu of piston.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.off_hand: Fires from the off hand on the use key. A one-handed gun in each hand fires one on each button, each with its own count; a reload then takes much longer.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.bayonet: A fixed blade under the barrel. Gun-fu Bayonet Drill thrusts with it.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.gun_braced: Crouched and still, the stock or the frame takes the kick: %1$s%% less kick and %2$s%% tighter.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.open_bolt: Fires from an open bolt: nothing in the chamber to cook off. After %1$s s without firing the first shot sprays x%2$s wider.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.belt_fed: The rounds are a chain: a reload takes x%1$s as long.
modular.feedback.desc.trait.fan: Crouched, hold the attack button to slap the hammer as fast as the hand can: a rate no cycle limit gives, with the spread, kick and cylinder heat that costs.
feedback.gloss.modular.overstressed: the reference charge makes more pressure than the chamber is rated for (overpressure above 1)
modular.feedback.fig.peak_pressure.tip: What the reference charge makes in the case.
modular.feedback.fig.chamber_rating.tip: The most the chamber holds: the barrel's metal and wall. Past it the gun takes the force.
modular.feedback.fig.muzzle_speed.tip: How fast the bullet leaves, at the reference load.
modular.feedback.fig.muzzle_energy.tip: Work delivered to the bullet: bore, barrel length and pressure.
modular.feedback.fig.impulse.tip: Momentum of bullet and gas: what recoil is made from.
modular.feedback.fig.cycle.tip: Time between shots, including the hand's work on a manual action.
modular.feedback.fig.spread.tip: Cone half-angle at the muzzle; never zero.
modular.feedback.fig.kick.tip: Camera kick per shot: impulse over the gun's mass, less what the grip lets through.
modular.feedback.fig.coil.tip: 1 for a gun thrown by a field, 0 for a gas.
modular.feedback.fig.report.tip: How loud a shot is against an open muzzle.
modular.feedback.fig.heat_factor.tip: Heat a shot leaves in the gun against an open muzzle.
modular.feedback.fig.shed_factor.tip: How fast the barrel sheds heat against a bare one.
modular.feedback.fig.overpressure.tip: Charge pressure over the chamber rating. Above 1 the force goes into the gun.
gun.feedback.build: %1$s mm bore, %2$s m barrel, %3$s mm wall, %4$s sight, %5$s, %6$s
gui.feedback.tool_table.tip.round: A loaded round. Nothing is spent.
gui.feedback.blueprint_table.remove: Take this part off the drawing
gui.feedback.blueprint_table.paper: Blueprint paper. A printed one opens to edit.
modular.feedback.role.barrel.tip: Where the bullet is guided. Its bore sets the calibre; length sets muzzle speed against weight.
modular.feedback.role.receiver.tip: The frame everything else bolts to. Its shape decides what kind of gun this is.
modular.feedback.role.second_barrel.tip: A second tube beside the first. Two shots ready, more weight and kick to hold.
modular.feedback.role.slide.tip: Reciprocating cover that cycles the action by blowback: self-loading.
modular.feedback.role.bolt.tip: A bolt that locks the breech: a stronger action, worked by hand or gas.
modular.feedback.role.trigger.tip: Releases the action. Sits in the receiver.
modular.feedback.role.grip.tip: What the hand holds. Sets how the gun settles under recoil.
modular.feedback.role.cylinder.tip: A rotating drum of chambers fed in turn: a revolver.
modular.feedback.role.tube.tip: A tube under the barrel holding rounds in a row.
modular.feedback.role.belt.tip: A belt of linked rounds feeding a machine gun.
modular.feedback.role.sight.tip: Aiming aid. Tightens how well you hit where you point.
modular.feedback.role.suppressor.tip: Baffled can on the muzzle: quieter and less flash, at some cost to speed.
modular.feedback.role.muzzle_brake.tip: Vents gas sideways to tame recoil.
modular.feedback.role.eddy_sleeve.tip: A conducting sleeve on a coil gun that damps the field.
modular.feedback.role.vent.tip: Lets heat and gas out of the action.
modular.feedback.role.shroud.tip: A cover around the barrel that sheds heat.
modular.feedback.role.winding.tip: The coil of wire that pulls a slug in a coil gun.
modular.feedback.role.wrap.tip: Wrapping on the grip: a surer hold.
modular.feedback.role.head.tip: The business end. Its material and shape set damage and dig speed.
modular.feedback.role.second_head.tip: The other end of a twin-headed tool.
modular.feedback.role.handle.tip: What you hold. Longer handles reach further and swing slower.
modular.feedback.role.binding.tip: Lashing where head meets handle. Takes some of the shock.
modular.feedback.role.tip.tip: A hard piece set into the working edge. Lends it hardness.
modular.feedback.role.blade.tip: The cutting part. Its material sets edge, wear and damage.
modular.feedback.role.guard.tip: Stops a blow sliding down onto the hand.
modular.feedback.role.pommel.tip: Counterweight at the hand end: moves the balance back.
modular.feedback.role.haft.tip: The long shaft of a polearm.
modular.feedback.role.shaft.tip: The long body: stiffer shafts fly truer.
modular.feedback.role.face.tip: The striking face of a shield or mace.
modular.feedback.role.rim.tip: Edge of a shield, takes the brunt of blows.
modular.feedback.role.limbs.tip: The springy arms of a bow: they store the energy.
modular.feedback.role.string.tip: Carries the limbs' energy to the arrow.
modular.feedback.role.stock.tip: The body the crossbow's parts are fixed to.
modular.feedback.role.lock.tip: Holds the string drawn until released.
modular.feedback.role.pivot.tip: The hinge the blades turn on.
modular.feedback.role.plate.tip: The main armour. Better plate takes more of every blow.
modular.feedback.role.lining.tip: Padding worn under the plate; it softens what gets through.
message.feedback.blueprint_table.no_pape: Put paper in the slot to print.
item.feedback.unlearning_token.used: You unlearn everything. Your points are returned.
item.feedback.unlearning_token.nothing: You have learned nothing to unlearn.
skill.feedback.tree.chaos.desc: Leaves targets with what you did to them, and it spreads: worn armour stays worn, stripped weapons stay stripped, fire passes to the next body, a shove knocks one body into another.
skill.feedback.move.rend.desc: Cast: a short blow that grinds the target's worn armour. Each piece loses durability by your weapon's hardness against that piece's, and your weapon is worn in turn by the hardest piece struck. Nothing worn, nothing happens. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.sunder.desc: Cast: a heavy blow into the shield or weapon the target holds. A raised shield is split and disabled; a held weapon is worn, and struck from the hand to lie on the ground if yours is half again as hard. Your weapon is worn by theirs. Rearms when you stagger something. Costs 30 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.kindle.desc: Cast: touch a held item above the burn line to the ground ahead. Every flammable block and living thing within two blocks catches fire, burning longer the hotter the item, and the fire passes to bodies beside them. The item cools by what it lit and scalds your hand. Rearms on a landed blow. Costs 20 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.barge.desc: Cast: a shoulder into the body ahead. It is staggered by your mass (armour counts) and sent along your line, faster the more you outweigh it; whatever it meets is staggered by its own mass at that speed. A body too heavy to move is not shoved. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.stampede.desc: Cast: a roar that sends every burning creature within nine blocks bolting away from you at a gallop, carrying their fire into whatever they pass. Rearms when you stagger something. Costs 20 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_powder_burn.d: A close shot leaves a powder burn on the target for ten seconds, up to five stacked; your next melee blow spends them as damage. Price: you have to get close, and the burn fades.
skill.feedback.figure.carry_ratio: Carry up to %s times more of your weight
skill.feedback.move.fist_jab.desc: Standing on the ground, an unarmed blow reaches a little further. Price: only standing; it is the start of the chain. A move landing soon after the one before it in the chain hits 30% harder.
skill.feedback.move.fist_lunge.desc: A sprinting unarmed blow staggers half again as hard and guards you for a few ticks. Price: you have to be at a run, and it comes after Jab. A move landing soon after the one before it in the chain hits 30% harder.
skill.feedback.move.fist_sweep.desc: A standing unarmed blow also strikes everything across a wide arc in front of you at part damage. Price: standing still, and it comes after Jab. A move landing soon after the one before it in the chain hits 30% harder.
skill.feedback.move.fist_chop.desc: A falling unarmed blow drives the target down. Price: you have to be falling; it follows a Lunge. A move landing soon after the one before it in the chain hits 30% harder.
skill.feedback.move.uppercut.desc: Cast: bare-handed. A quick windup, then one punch for seven damage that launches a body about seven blocks up. A miss leaves you staggered for a moment. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_brand.desc: A whip with the barrel above the burn line sears the target by the barrel's temperature, and the barrel gives up some heat. The more you fired first, the harder it brands. Price: you shot to get it hot, and a hot barrel burns your own hand.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_muzzle_stagge: A point-blank shot just after a whip lands its impulse as stagger on the target, over the target's mass: a heavy bore shoves hard, a small one barely. Price: you have to be on top of them; spent until you land a blow.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_bayonet.desc: With a bayonet lug fitted the swing is a thrust that rides the gun's own cycle, hitting by the bayonet metal's hardness. Price: the lug is a part you must build and carry.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_braced.desc: Recoil is momentum. Opens the recoil techniques.
A shot fired airborne or against a surface pushes you by the gun's impulse over your mass: a rifle launches you, a pocket pistol nudges. Price: a hot or worn gun wears faster when used as a thruster.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_braced_fire.d: Shooting braced (crouched against a block, or in the air against a wall) sheds most of the heat bloom of the spread. Price: it needs terrain.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_hot_clear.des: Sneak-reload with the barrel near cook-off ejects the chambered round unfired. Price: it only helps where cook-off is a danger.
Rolling through an attack clears the gun's cycle wait, so the next shot is ready at once. Price: the roll has to cross a blow, and it rearms on the clock.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_spent_case_dr: Reloading during a roll takes only as long as the roll has left. Price: the reload still needs the roll to be long enough.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_return_fire.d: A weapon parry in its window turns a bullet back at the shooter carrying the round's own energy, not a multiple. Price: the parry timing, and the blow wears the weapon.
skill.feedback.move.quake_leap.desc: Cast: vault forward and up, and land hard. The landing shoves everything within reach and staggers it by your mass (armour counts) and how far you fell, over each target's own mass. A heavy armoured fighter shakes the ground. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.whirl.desc: Cast: a full turn with the held weapon, striking everything in reach at four-fifths of its damage and staggering it by that damage over its mass. Rearms when you stagger something, so it chains off a parry or a kick. Costs 30 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.forge_slam.desc: Cast: slam a held item above the burn line into the ground. A ring of searing goes out by its temperature, and the item gives up heat to it, more the more it burns. A forge-fresh blade is a bomb for one swing. Costs 30 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.flurry.desc: Cast, empty-handed: six quick blows on whoever you face, the last one a stagger. Costs 30 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.shadow_step.desc: Cast: vanish and step in behind the nearest thing in front of you, within nine blocks, on the side it is not facing. Needs room to stand there. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.ambush.desc: The first blow within three seconds of a Shadow step staggers its target, by the blow over its mass, tripled, whatever it was facing. The step is the opening; a dagger's backstab is a different thing (the weapon's own).
skill.feedback.move.walking_fire.desc: Cast: three rounds from the held gun, each laid on the next target in front of you, so one press sweeps a room. Every round heats the barrel and spends ammo as usual. Costs 30 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.muzzle_flash.desc: Cast: fire the gun as a blast. The round's baked impulse is the stagger of everything in the cone in front, and the flash blinds it. A heavy bore staggers a lot, a light one barely. Costs 30 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.dead_eye.desc: Always on: a shot taken crouched and standing still leaves exact, with no spread, and its round counts as twice as hard against armour.
skill.feedback.move.dropkick.desc: Cast, in the air: dive forward and down; the landing is a kick on whatever is under you, by your mass (armour counts) over its. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.brace.desc: Always on while crouched: knockback cannot move you, and every blow taken is held by your mass (armour counts) against the attacker's. The held share is not taken, it goes into the attacker as stagger, and the held weapon wears for it.
skill.feedback.move.shield_wall.desc: Cast, with a shield or blocking item in hand: for three seconds anything that comes at you inside the cone in front is turned back and staggered once, by its mass and speed. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.reckoning.desc: Cast: the damage your parries took in the last ten seconds is banked, and this lets it go as one blow at what you face, staggering it by twice that. The harder you were hit, the harder it lands. Rearms when you stagger something. Costs 30 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.reprisal.desc: Always on: every parry you land is answered at once with a blow at whoever struck, for your attack damage, and staggers them.
skill.feedback.move.pin_down.desc: Always on, with a gun: any round you fire that passes close to a living thing slows it hard for two seconds, hit or not. The crack of a near miss is what pins them; area denial from a gun that is not trying to hit.
skill.feedback.move.hamstring.desc: Cast: a low cut at what you face, for seven tenths of the weapon's damage, that cripples its legs: slowed hard for four seconds. A fighter that cannot close or flee is a fighter you choose the range against. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.mark_and_fire.desc: Held cast, with a hammer-and-cylinder gun (a revolver): hold the key and your sights on things, and each beat marks one more of the rounds chambered, a thing can take several. Let go, fill the cylinder or run dry of stamina, and the hammer lets go: you swing round to each mark in turn and put an exact shot in it, two ticks apart. You walk slowly while laying it and have six seconds. Every round still heats the barrel and spends ammo. Costs 10 stamina, then 4 a second while held.
skill.feedback.move.coin_flip.desc: Cast: toss a coin and shoot it. A harder coin than the round rebounds it to the nearest thing within 24 blocks that has a clear line from the coin, seen or not; a softer one is punched through. Heavy coins slow the round. Price: a stamped coin, 15 stamina, and it rearms when you land a blow, or after 30 s out of a fight.
skill.feedback.move.second_mark.desc: The coin cast may be used twice: a second coin goes up while the first is still in the air, with no rearm of its own. A rebound goes into the other coin first, so you can shoot a coin into a coin and on to a target. Price: a second stamped coin and a second 15 stamina, and the shot has to be fast.
skill.feedback.move.round_the_corner.des: The rebound looks three times as far for a target. Price: it still needs a clear line from the coin, and it gives up the second press.
skill.feedback.move.searing_strike.desc: Any held item above the burn line sears what a landed blow hits: a blade fresh from the fire, never keyed on what it is. The item cools. Price: a hot hand burns you, and the heat is spent.
skill.feedback.move.feint.desc: With a one-handed weapon in each hand, an off-hand strike pressed while your main hand is mid-swing cuts in at once at full strength and the target flinches. Price: spent until you land a blow.
skill.feedback.move.draw_switch.desc: Swapping to a weapon of a different build family gives you the swing back at once instead of restarting the recharge. Price: you carry two kinds of weapon, and it rearms on the clock.
skill.feedback.move.last_stand.desc: Taking a hit that leaves you at 3 hearts or less makes the next roll that swallows a blow a free parry: the attacker is staggered and your riposte opens. Price: it takes a hit to arm, and it rearms only by the clock.
skill.feedback.move.kick.desc: Cast: drive a kick into whatever is in front: a stagger from your mass (armour counts) against the target's. Needs the skill; gear can grant it. Wall Smash and Breach Kick build on it.
skill.feedback.move.grab.desc: Cast: take hold of what is in front of you, bare-handed. A worn glove improves it: a longer hold, and heavier targets. Throw and the grip nodes build on it.
skill.feedback.move.shove.desc: Cast, held: put your hands on a vehicle body and keep the key down. A body no heavier than you and your armour (the carry ratio) is held up in front of the camera like a prop. A heavier one is shoved along the ground as you walk or sprint, or dragged back as you step away, by your mass times your speed at the point you touched, and it pushes back on you equally; its tyres' grip and brake pads do the resisting, so a braked car stays put. Costs stamina for the work you deliver, and more to hold up more weight. Standing on a body, or being pulled too far from it, lets go. Pushing a body earns Brute points, fewer the more you repeat it.
skill.feedback.move.throw.desc: Release a staggered body you have pulled in (a grab, or a grapple that reached you) past you along your look; mass decides how far, and whatever stands there does the rest. Price: you are left in reach, recovering. Spent until you stagger something.
skill.feedback.move.quarry_mark.desc: A bow or crossbow hit out at range makes the target glow for as long as the arrow carried energy: a hard draw marks for seconds, a short one barely. Twin of the gun skills. Price: nothing within six blocks, and a dead target is not marked.
skill.feedback.move.far_sight.desc: A hard-drawn arrow flies flat for its first second before it starts to drop, so a long shot needs no lead. Price: only a near-full draw, and it drops after the second.
skill.feedback.move.point_blank_draw.des: A bow or crossbow hit within four blocks staggers the target by the arrow's energy over the target's mass: a hard draw shoves a light body, a heavy one hardly moves. Twin of Muzzle stagger. Price: you have to be on top of them.
skill.feedback.move.barbed_shaft.desc: A close bow or crossbow hit leaves a barb in the target for ten seconds; your next melee blow spends the barbs as damage, up to five. Twin of Marked rounds. Price: you have to get close, and the barbs work loose.
skill.feedback.move.braced_draw.desc: An arrow loosed braced against terrain (crouched against a block, or on a wall) leaves exactly down your sight line with no scatter. Twin of Braced fire. Price: you have to be braced.
skill.feedback.move.snap_shot.desc: After a roll that swallowed a blow, your next arrow leaves at full draw however briefly you drew. Twin of Dodge charge. Price: the roll has to cross a blow, and it fades after three seconds.
skill.feedback.move.quarry_breath.desc: Killing at range with a bow or crossbow gives stamina back by the arrow's energy. Twin of Hot clear. Price: the kill has to be six blocks or more away.
skill.feedback.move.far_end.desc: Blows landing out at the tip of your reach hit harder, more the more head-heavy the weapon. Price: up close you get nothing. Excludes Close work.
skill.feedback.move.close_work.desc: Blows landing inside half your reach recharge the swing faster. Price: at the tip you get nothing. Excludes Far end.
skill.feedback.move.pry_open.desc: A blow landing on a target whose weapon was just beaten (staggered, or guard up) binds that hand; a raised shield is disabled instead. Softer, more worn steel binds longer. Price: only on an opening, and spent until you parry.
skill.feedback.move.wall_smash.desc: A kick that sends a foe into a wall adds the weight of the armour they wear to the stagger. Price: it needs a wall at their back.
skill.feedback.move.wall_rebound.desc: A wall kick keeps its momentum for one more kick off a second wall before you touch ground. Price: it needs a second wall.
skill.feedback.move.breach_kick.desc: A kick on a target already staggered knocks it down; on a steady one it only shoves. Kick what is already broken.
skill.feedback.figure.running_bolt: Open-bolt sustained fire spread and kick %s (fraction off)
skill.feedback.move.forge_cadence.desc: Always on, at the forge: every three clean blows in a row raise your tempo one step (a pip under the beat lights), and each blow struck at a step lands eight percent more Work per step, filling what lighter blows left short. A miss drops the tempo to nothing. Clean forging streaks also earn Onslaught points, less for each repeat of the same shape.
skill.feedback.move.forge_steady.desc: Always on, at the forge: a loose blow (close to the beat, not on it) holds your tempo instead of dropping it, once per run. A miss still drops it.
skill.feedback.move.throwback.desc: A parry made with the off hand empty returns the attacker's stagger doubled; the riposte window is your free counter. Price: a free hand, so no shield or dual wield.
skill.feedback.move.slip.desc: A parry on the window's very last tick turns into a step-through: the blow whiffs and you end up behind the attacker. Price: the last tick is the narrow one, and a missed slip is normal recovery.
skill.feedback.move.answer.desc: The first blow after a clean parry is blocked outright. Price: the guard rearms only when you land a blow, so waiting buys nothing.
skill.feedback.move.roll_with_it.desc: A parry on the last tick takes the blow on the weapon's flat: excess force becomes extra stagger on the attacker instead of weapon wear. Price: the late tick.
skill.feedback.move.riposte.desc: After a successful parry, your next melee hit within 1.5 s (30 ticks) deals 1.5x damage.
skill.feedback.move.wall_kick.desc: Tap jump in the air, facing a wall, within 1.2 s of sprinting or rolling on the ground, to kick off it, up and back. Costs hunger; resets fall distance.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_pistol_whip.d: Hold the melee-stance key to swing a held gun as a bludgeon. Damage and recovery follow the gun's mass.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_chamber.desc: A pistol-whip heavy enough to stagger the target fires a free shot at it. Needs a loaded gun; one stagger, one shot.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_dual.desc: The off-hand gun can pistol-whip too, on its own cooldown.
skill.feedback.move.gun_fu_spin.desc: Sneak while pistol-whipping to spin: hits every body within 2 blocks, but recovery is 1.5x longer.
skill.feedback.move.blade_flourish.desc: A landed blade hit takes 10 ticks off the roll cooldown (parry and kick wait on it too).
skill.feedback.move.mace_quake.desc: A mace blow of 5+ damage shakes the ground: bodies within 2.5 blocks of the target are knocked back and staggered.
skill.feedback.move.spear_vault.desc: A spear thrust landed while sprinting on the ground vaults you up and forward. 2 s cooldown.
feedback.stand.nothing: Needs water and something in it.
feedback.stand.dud: The brew comes out a dud.
feedback.stand.status: %s bottles of water, %s ingredients, %s bottles waiting
gui.feedback.stand.title: Brewing Stand
gui.feedback.stand.hint: Stir in circles over the map. Hover an ingredient to see where it would take the marker.
gui.feedback.enchant.gate.part.off: Seat a part in the slot.
gui.feedback.enchant.gate.heat.ok: Hot: the session costs less, but the part cools while you write and the window closes.
gui.feedback.enchant.gate.heat.off: Cold: full price, but the part never runs out of time.
gui.feedback.enchant.gate.effect.no: The part has no room for more.
gui.feedback.enchant.gate.effect.off: Pick an effect from the list.
gui.feedback.enchant.gate.xp.off: A session costs %s. A Creative XP source beside the table can pay it.
message.feedback.enchant.attuned: This part can take no more attunements.
message.feedback.enchant.lost: The session was lost. Nothing was spent; try again.
message.feedback.enchant.nothing: Nothing took. The experience is gone.
message.feedback.enchant.flawed: The enchantment took, but the part is flawed.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.draw: draws lightning to the holder in a thunderstorm under open sky, and calls a bolt on everything it hits, or on the ground a slam strikes.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.fling: Throws the drops of what you kill away (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.fling: throws the drops of whatever the blow kills away from the wielder. Goes dead when the part is hotter than its Curie point.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_draw: while worn, loose items nearby drift toward you. Goes dead when the part is hotter than its Curie point.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_fling: while worn, arrows and tridents with metal in them are turned aside before they hit you. Goes dead when the part is hotter than its Curie point.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.ring: a landed blow rings, so sculk and nearby hostile mobs notice it from further.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.hush: A landed blow makes no sound (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.hush: the blow and the hurt it causes make no vibration for sculk to feel.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_ring: while worn, your steps and the hits you take ring, so sculk and nearby hostile mobs notice you.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.worn_hush: Worn: steps and hits are silent (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_hush: while worn, your steps and the hits you take make no vibration for sculk to feel.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.stick: A landed blow sticks and slows (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.stick: a landed blow sticks to the target and slows it, longer the grippier the material.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.slick: A landed blow knocks the target sliding (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.slick: a landed blow knocks the target further along, more the slipperier the material.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_grip: on a boot, stops a slide on slippery ground when you are not pushing, more the grippier the material.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_slick: on a boot, lets you skate faster on any ground but stops poorly.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.glow: while held, carries a light that moves with you.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.dim: Held: hides you in the dark (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.dim: while held, hostile mobs beyond a short range do not take you up as a target while you stand in low light.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_glow: while worn, carries a light that moves with you.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.worn_dim: Worn: hides you in the dark (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_dim: while worn, hostile mobs beyond a short range do not take you up as a target while you stand in low light.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_lure: while worn, draws passive animals nearby toward you, no item in hand needed.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.worn_scare: Worn: scatters animals and weak monsters (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_scare: while worn, animals and weak hostile mobs nearby keep their distance from you.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.worn_grow: Worn on boots: walking grows crops and grass (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_grow: on boots, walking grows crops and spreads grass underfoot every few blocks.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.worn_reap: Worn on boots: walking reaps ripe crops (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_reap: on boots, walking over ripe crops harvests and replants them every few blocks.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.worn_reserve: Worn: sprinting and fighting cost less hunger (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_reser: cuts the hunger you burn from sprinting and fighting.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.worn_famine: Worn: whoever hits you loses hunger (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_famin: whoever hits you loses food if a player, or is weakened if a mob.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.worn_sprint: Worn on legs or boots: the longer you run straight, the faster (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_sprin: on legs or boots, the longer you run in a straight line the faster you go, to a cap; stopping or a sharp turn resets it.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.worn_stance: Worn: standing still builds damage reduction (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_stanc: the longer you stand still the less damage you take, to a cap; moving resets it.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.momentum: Hits harder after a straight sprint (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.momentum: hits harder and knocks further the longer you ran in a straight line before the blow; a spear jab after a sprint is the best hit.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.brace: hits harder the longer you have stood still; moving breaks it.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.pack: Hits harder for each ally near (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.pack: hits harder for each ally within a few blocks: same team, same tamed owner, or a golem.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.pack_guard: Takes less from a hit for each ally near (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.pack_guard: turns away more of a hit for each ally within a few blocks.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.lone: Hits harder with no ally near (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.lone: hits harder when no ally is within a few blocks.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.lone_guard: Takes less from a hit with no ally near (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.lone_guard: turns away more of a hit when no ally is within a few blocks.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.mark: marks the target, which glows; the next blow on it, from anyone, does extra.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.taunt: Draws hostile mobs onto the wearer (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.taunt: marks its wearer, so hostile mobs nearby turn on them. Brittle.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.echo_blow: Repeats each blow a beat later (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.echo_blow: repeats each blow on the same target a beat later, at a share of its damage.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.echo_wear: wears the part extra on every hit you take. The damage is unchanged.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.lag_blow: makes each swing land a few seconds after it is struck.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.lag_hit: puts off a share of each hit you take and delivers it over the next few seconds.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.gamble: flips a coin on each blow: it lands for double damage, or heals the target instead.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.gamble_war: flips a coin on each hit you take: it does double damage, or none at all.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.feed: restores food and saturation on a kill, and costs a little hunger on every blow.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.drain: takes food from a player it hits, and weakens a mob.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.grudge: Damage you take fills the charge bar (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.grudge: damage the wearer takes is stored in the charge bar of the Charge tool in hand, to be spent by the next release.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.calm: Damage you take drains the charge bar (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.calm: damage the wearer takes bleeds stored charge from the Charge tool in hand.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.grow: Swing grows crops and grass nearby (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.grow: a swing at the ground grows crops and spreads grass in a small area, then cools down.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.reap: a swing at the ground harvests and replants ripe crops in a small area, then cools down.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.lure: while held, draws passive animals nearby toward you.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.scare: while held, animals and weak hostile mobs nearby flee from you.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.pulse: Strikes a Leyden jar to charge it by hand (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.pulse: strikes charge a Leyden jar a little by hand; a blow on anything else is lost.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.sense: Tells you how hard each blow landed (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.sense: tells you in words how hard each landed blow was; it controls nothing.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.reserve: holds experience points. Sneak-use in the air stores some of yours, sneak-use on a creative experience source fills it; mending draws on it before you.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.build: Each blow builds charge, released on a sneak-use (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.build: each blow builds charge; sneak-use arms a release that spends it all in the next blow (or, on a head that also draws lightning, spends some to call a bolt in any weather). Too much charge arcs through the wielder unless the handle insulates.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.capacitor: Widens the charge bar of the tool in hand (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.capacitor: while worn, widens the charge bar of a Charge tool in hand: more charge held before it arcs.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.bleed: Sheds charge each blow, a ground strap (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.bleed: sheds stored charge each blow, and the wielder is never arced.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.point_magn: a needle in the action bar leans toward the nearest block of iron-bearing rock. It dies when the part is heated past its Curie point.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.away_magne: a needle in the action bar leans away from the nearest block of iron-bearing rock. It dies when the part is heated past its Curie point.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.point_dens: a needle in the action bar leans toward the nearest block of the heavy seams.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.away_dense: Needle away from the heavy seams (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.away_dense: a needle in the action bar leans away from the nearest block of the heavy seams.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.point_conductiv: Needle toward metals that carry current (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.point_cond: a needle in the action bar leans toward the nearest block of metals that carry current.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.away_conductive: Needle away from metals that carry current (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.away_condu: a needle in the action bar leans away from the nearest block of metals that carry current.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.point_flam: a needle in the action bar leans toward the nearest block of what will burn.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.away_flammable: Needle away from what will burn (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.away_flamm: a needle in the action bar leans away from the nearest block of what will burn.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_point: when nothing held reads, a needle in the action bar leans toward the nearest block of iron-bearing rock. It dies when the part is heated past its Curie point.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.worn_away_magne: Worn needle away from iron-bearing rock (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_away_: when nothing held reads, a needle in the action bar leans away from the nearest block of iron-bearing rock. It dies when the part is heated past its Curie point.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.worn_point_dens: Worn needle toward the heavy seams (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_point: when nothing held reads, a needle in the action bar leans toward the nearest block of the heavy seams.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.worn_away_dense: Worn needle away from the heavy seams (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_away_: when nothing held reads, a needle in the action bar leans away from the nearest block of the heavy seams.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.worn_point_cond: Worn needle toward metals that carry current (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_point: when nothing held reads, a needle in the action bar leans toward the nearest block of metals that carry current.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.worn_away_condu: Worn needle away from metals that carry current (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_away_: when nothing held reads, a needle in the action bar leans away from the nearest block of metals that carry current.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.worn_point_flam: Worn needle toward what will burn (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_point: when nothing held reads, a needle in the action bar leans toward the nearest block of what will burn.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.worn_away_flamm: Worn needle away from what will burn (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.worn_away_: when nothing held reads, a needle in the action bar leans away from the nearest block of what will burn.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.arc: A blow it takes arcs onto the attacker (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.arc: a blow it takes arcs onto whatever struck it, harder for a harder hit; an insulating plate arcs nothing.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.soak: turns away some of the wear each use causes.
feedback.reservoir.full: The reservoir is full, or you have none to give.
feedback.charge.armed: Charge armed: the next blow releases it.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.insulate: Turns fire away from the wearer (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.insulate: turns fire damage away from the wearer, better the poorer a conductor the material is.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.mend: repairs itself while held or worn, paid for in your experience points; it drains the experience you wanted to keep.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.fortune: gets more out of what it breaks or kills.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.intact: breaks blocks out whole, not into their loot.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.recall: a magnetic head pulls the weapon back to the thrower after it lands.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.anchor: a thrown weapon that strikes plants the target, which cannot move for a short time.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.rewind: sneak-use snaps the wearer back to where they stood a few seconds ago, with a long cooldown and a little wear; it refuses if the spot is blocked.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.coil: on legs or boots, holding sneak compresses the wearer and a jump releases a launch scaled by the hold, with a little wear per release.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.scavenge: worn, it adds a share to every experience orb picked up, up to a cap.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.store: stores more draw energy, so the shot leaves faster at the same draw time.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.release: lets go sooner, so the draw or load takes less time.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.seal: Seals against water, breath lasts longer (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.seal: seals out water, so breath lasts longer.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.stride: cuts the drag of wading through water.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.clamp: Cannot be thrown from the hand (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.clamp: clamps to the hand, so the tool cannot be dropped.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.freeze: Stacks freezing on what it strikes (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.freeze: stacks freezing on what it strikes, slowing it and then hurting it.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.walker: cools lava under the wearer's feet to obsidian, which runs again soon after. Boots only.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.douse: Puts out fires, and hurts what water hurts (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.douse: puts out what it strikes and the fires it is used beside, and hurts blazes and anything else water hurts.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.slip: May leave the hand when it strikes (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.slip: may slip from your hand when you strike, but the loose handle gives under force.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.kickback: Throws you and what you hit apart when it fires (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.kickback: recoils hard when it fires: you are thrown back along the shot and the target is thrown the other way.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.kin_calm: Calms what it strikes among the undead, and they hit harder for it (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.kin_calm: makes the undead it strikes lose interest in you for a while, but they hit harder while it lasts.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.kin_hide: The undead notice you from less far, and hit harder (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.kin_hide: makes the undead notice the wearer from less far away, but they hit harder when they do.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.pad: Spreads the blow: less damage, a stagger (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.pad: turns part of the damage into a stagger, slowing and weakening what it strikes.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.pull: Draws what it strikes toward you (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.pull: draws what it strikes in toward the wielder.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.drag: Draws you and what you hit together when it fires (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.drag: pulls the shooter after the shot and the target back toward them when it fires.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.tithe: Pays experience for kills, and wears for it (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.tithe: pays out experience for what it kills and wears a little for each kill.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.limber: frees the legs, so crouching is less slow.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.shed: sheds the damage and fire of lightning.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.deflect: turns projectiles aside, the harder the better.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.bane: Cuts deeper into the undead and arthropods (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.bane: cuts deeper into the undead and arthropods.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.bane_ward: Blunts blows from the undead and arthropods (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.bane_ward: blunts blows from the undead and arthropods.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.shove: throws back what it strikes, heavy things less.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.recoil: kicks the wielder back when they strike.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.reflect: Returns a share of the blow to the attacker (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.reflect: returns a share of each blow to whoever struck the wearer.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.burn_wield: burns the hand that holds it.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.desc.ignite_att: sets whoever strikes the wearer alight.
tooltip.feedback.attuned.burn_wielder: Burns the hand that holds it (%s)
tooltip.feedback.attuned.ignite_attacker: Sets whoever strikes the wearer alight (%s)
message.feedback.mixer.refused: The drum takes loose propellant powder only, up to a full charge, and never a coil's drive with a gas.
feedback.jade.radioactive: Gives off %s Ru at point blank
feedback.jade.shielded: Lead-lined: what it holds does not radiate
feedback.survey.none: Nothing within reach reads above the noise.
modular.feedback.desc.part.box_feed: A well under a bolt or lever action that takes a box magazine. Without it the action loads one round by hand.
message.feedback.pivot.differential.1: Open differential: the two half-axles turn at different speeds
message.feedback.pivot.differential.2: Limited slip differential: the half-axles are held near each other's speed
message.feedback.pivot.differential.3: Locked differential: both half-axles turn as one rod
message.feedback.pivot.slider: Slider (a spring): slides along %s, held by a spring and a shock
message.feedback.transmission.no_design: A transmission with no design has nothing to shift.
feedback.gloss.cut: reads up to %1$s Qu, in steps of %2$s Qu
tooltip.feedback.role.substrate: The base a trace board is built on.
tooltip.feedback.role.solder: Pastes a trace board; heat the joint to set it.
tooltip.feedback.role.rectifier: A switching part: mount it on a trace board, or seat it in a cat's whisker detector.
tooltip.feedback.role.board: Mount a part, paste it with solder, then heat the joint: it becomes a circuit.
tooltip.feedback.role.circuit: Fit it on a cat's whisker detector's contact for a quieter, further-hearing report.
advancement.feedback.electronics.root.de: A circuit is a board with a switching part on it. First a base: grind a brick flat on a grinding wheel to get a substrate.
advancement.feedback.electronics.substra: Lay traces: a substrate and redstone dust in a crafting grid. Then put a coherer (no ore needed) on the board in the grid, and paste it with a tin ingot.
advancement.feedback.electronics.board.d: Heat a soldering iron at a fire. Hold the pasted board in the other hand, right-click, and drag the tip along the pads at a steady pace.
advancement.feedback.electronics.circuit: Fit it on a cat's whisker detector's contact and read it with a component tester.
feedback.circuit.lifted: Traces lifted: the circuit is dead
feedback.better_combat_notice: Feedback is borrowing Better Combat's animations. If something looks wrong, report it to Feedback, never to Better Combat's author.
skill.feedback.move.wall_run.desc: Cast: with a wall beside you, run along it for most of a second, the wall taking your weight; look steers, crouch drops you. Reads whether a wall is at your side and your sprint. Costs 20 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.vault.desc: Cast: spring off the shoulders of the nearest thing in front and land behind it; it is staggered by your mass pushed off it. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.slide.desc: Cast: from a sprint, skid low along the ground; every body in the way is tripped once, staggered by your mass (armour counts). Costs 15 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.smoke_step.desc: Cast: roll out of a cloud left where you stood; for three seconds anything inside it loses you as a target, unless it is already at your elbow. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.thick_smoke.desc: Rider: Smoke step's cloud is half again as wide and lasts five seconds.
skill.feedback.move.vanish.desc: Cast: invisible for about five seconds, less the more armour you wear (mass clanks); landing a blow gives you away. Reads worn armour mass. Costs 20 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.long_shadow.desc: Rider: Vanish lasts three seconds longer.
skill.feedback.move.pocket_sand.desc: Cast: throw a fistful of the ground at the eyes of a cone: loose sand blinds six seconds, dirt three, bare stone gives you nothing to throw. Targets lose you and flinch. Reads the block underfoot. Costs 15 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.grit.desc: Rider: Pocket sand blinds two seconds longer, and crushed stone underfoot will do.
skill.feedback.move.challenge.desc: Cast: ring your weapon on your guard; every hostile within ten blocks turns on you. The weapon pays a point of wear for the noise. Costs 15 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.advance.desc: Cast: for three seconds walk forward behind a held guard; everything in front is shoved back by the ratio of your mass to its, and the lighter ones are staggered. Needs a shield-type item. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.punish.desc: Cast: a heavy blow, over twice the weapon's damage, on the nearest thing in reach that is already staggered; nothing standing steady will take it. Rearms on a stagger. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.rebuke.desc: Always on: every melee blow you take is struck back at the attacker for six tenths of what it dealt. You still take all of it.
skill.feedback.move.rising_tempo.desc: Always on: with empty hands, each blow you land within a second and a half of the last is fifteen percent harder than the one before, to eight deep. A pause breaks the chain.
skill.feedback.move.frenzy.desc: Cast: with empty hands, swing eighty percent faster for five seconds; afterwards three seconds of swinging a third slower, winded. Costs 30 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.haymaker.desc: Cast: wind up for half a second, then one punch for nine damage that shoves a body back by your mass over its. A miss leaves you staggered. Costs 30 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.stomp.desc: Cast: your whole weight on the nearest staggered thing in reach, as damage and a fresh stagger. Nothing standing steady will take it. Rearms on a stagger. Costs 20 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.crush.desc: Rider: Stomp hurts half again as much.
skill.feedback.move.axe_kick.desc: Cast: an overhead heel on the nearest thing in front; a raised guard is broken and its bearer staggered by your mass. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.rending_heel.desc: Rider: Axe kick also wears the target's armour, a heel's hardness against each piece's.
skill.feedback.move.reel_in.desc: Cast: haul the nearest thing within twelve blocks to you on a line; it arrives staggered by your mass (faster reel nodes hit harder). A body over two and a half times your mass will not come. Costs 20 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.conduct.desc: Cast: fix a line to the live bare conductor nearest your look (twelve blocks) and haul the nearest thing ahead along it; on arrival it is shocked by the wire's volts and staggered, and so are you unless your hands are proof against them (rubber gloves). Insulated or dead wire does nothing. Costs 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.hitch.desc: Cast: fix a line to a vehicle block within twenty-four blocks and be towed behind it. Crouch to let go; the line parts if the stretch passes what your body mass holds, or after four seconds. The vehicle feels nothing. Costs 20 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.bowling.desc: Throw upgrade: the thrown body flies as a ball for 25 ticks; everything it strikes is staggered by its mass (BodyMass, plus armour), and it takes the knocks too. Heavier bodies stagger harder. Price: the body is hurt by each strike.
skill.feedback.move.swing.desc: Cast: fix a line to the block you look at, four to twenty-four blocks away, and pendulum across the gap on it; crouch to let go. Reads the rope and your momentum. Costs 20 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.cleave.desc: Cast: raise a heavy weapon (damage 5 or more) and bring it down; the target takes the blow and a crack runs seven blocks on, staggering by the weapon's damage and fading with distance. Costs 30 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.dazzle.desc: Rider: Muzzle flash blinds for six seconds.
skill.feedback.move.concussive.desc: Rider: Muzzle flash staggers half again as hard.
skill.feedback.move.scorch.desc: Rider: Kindle and Searing strike leave their targets burning twice as long.
skill.feedback.move.called_shot.desc: Cast: the round is aimed not at where the thing under your crosshair is but at where its motion puts it by the time the round arrives. Needs line of sight, forty blocks at most. Costs a round, its heat and 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.point_blank.desc: Cast: fire into a body you hold or one already staggered within reach; the round's whole impulse is stagger and, past ten joules to the point, damage. Costs a round and 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.snap_volley.desc: Cast: up to three rounds, four ticks apart, each at the next nearest living thing in the forward cone. The gun's own cycle may refuse a follow-up; each round spends ammo and adds heat. Costs 30 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.human_shield.desc: Cast: the body you hold takes every blow aimed at you for as long as you hold it. If it dies, so does the cover. Needs a hold (Grab). Costs 20 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.disarm_shot.desc: Cast: a round aimed at the weapon hand of whoever you face within twenty blocks; if it leaves the muzzle, what they held falls at their feet and they flinch by the round's impulse. Costs a round and 25 stamina.
skill.feedback.move.field_dressing.desc: Held cast: stand still and hold the key to bind your wounds. Health comes back while you hold it, and stamina drains 25 a second, so a full bar buys about four hearts. Moving, taking damage, full health or an empty bar ends it: it is for between fights. Rearms on the clock.
skill.feedback.move.second_breath.desc: Cast: a deep breath that refills stamina to sixty and pauses its regen, as a rest does. Worn armour presses on the chest: heavy plate breathes to about forty. Costs no stamina; rearms when you land a blow.
skill.feedback.move.shake_off.desc: Cast: a hard full-body shake. If you are burning it beats the fire out; otherwise it clears the harmful effect with the most time left. One thing per cast. Rearms when you stagger something.
skill.feedback.move.wind_back.desc: A parry landed while your stamina is under 30 gives 15 back, without pausing regen. Price: you have to be low and still parry; rearms on the clock.
skill.feedback.move.grit_teeth.desc: Always on: every blow you take lands lighter by a share read off the armour you wear (15% bare, up to 55% in full plate), for 10 stamina a blow. With less than that in the bar the blow lands whole.
skill.feedback.move.break_free.desc: Shake off first throws off any rope someone else has on you (a grab, a hooked weapon) and staggers whoever held it, by their mass. Your own grapple is left alone.
skill.feedback.move.tend.desc: Held cast: stand still within two blocks of an ally who is hurt, and hold the key to bind their wounds. They mend as fast as Field dressing mends you, and stamina drains from you, 25 a second. Either of you moving, either taking damage, the ally at full health or an empty bar ends it. Rearms on the clock.
skill.feedback.move.haul_out.desc: Cast: put a line on an ally within twelve blocks and haul them to your feet, setting them down steady. A body over two and a half times your mass will not come. Costs 20 stamina; rearms on the clock.
skill.feedback.move.hand_off.desc: Cast: pass stamina to an ally within three blocks. You spend 30; 60% of it reaches them, the rest is lost in the handing over. Rearms on the clock.
skill.feedback.move.cut_loose.desc: Cast: cut an ally within five blocks free of every rope someone else has on them (a grab, a hooked weapon) and break the grab on them, staggering the holder by their mass. Costs 20 stamina; rearms on the clock.
skill.feedback.move.callused_hands.desc: Bare hands take the scald band: anything under 300 Tu can be held or touched unhurt. Burning and searing still hurt; gloves and tongs still do better.
skill.feedback.move.sear_shut.desc: A Cauterize with a piece hot enough to sear also clears the harmful effect with the most time left. Price: the sear's own burn and fire.
skill.feedback.move.blood_up.desc: Three empty-hand hits, each within three seconds of the last, with no damage taken between, heal one heart. Taking a hit breaks the run. Rearms on the clock.
skill.feedback.move.breather.desc: A kill with a modular weapon in your main hand gives back stamina by the weapon's mass: 10 a Mu, between 10 and 40. A heavy weapon earns a deep breath.
skill.feedback.move.cauterize.desc: Cast: press a hot piece from either hand to the wound. A piece hot enough to burn heals three hearts, one hot enough to sear heals six, and you take that band's burn and catch fire. The piece comes away 200 Tu cooler. Needs something at least burning hot in hand.
screen.feedback.skills.equip.tip.key: Press to slot the picked technique.
modular.feedback.role.container.tip: What the dish sits on, and what tells the table which dish it is: a bowl, a plate, a skewer or a baked flatbread. Its size caps how much meal there is and how long it takes to eat. Shaped at the Prep Table.
modular.feedback.role.base.tip: The bulk of the dish: a starchy food, such as a potato or bread.
modular.feedback.role.main.tip: The dense part: a protein, such as meat or fish. Every dish needs one.
modular.feedback.role.side.tip: Fibre and bulk: a plant food, such as a vegetable or fruit.
modular.feedback.role.finish.tip: A small, strong addition: a seasoning, such as honey. It moves the buff more than the hunger.
perk.feedback.settling.gloss: Eases nausea and food-poisoning sickness; strong cases are beyond it.
perk.feedback.warming.gloss: Stops the cold of powder snow from building up for a while; gives nothing against fire.
perk.feedback.cooling.gloss: Puts out burning sooner for a while; standing in lava still kills.
perk.feedback.antitoxin.gloss: Lowers the toxin in the same meal by a fraction; a deadly food stays deadly.
perk.feedback.antibiotic.gloss: Lowers the live pathogen in the same meal; rotten food is past help.
perk.feedback.antivenin.gloss: Eases poison I; stronger poison and wither are beyond it.
perk.feedback.sobering.gloss: Eases darkness, blindness and slowness up to level I.
perk.feedback.night_sight.gloss: Brief night vision, and blindness cannot land while it lasts; leaves you briefly slowed.
perk.feedback.fortifying.gloss: Lengthens the other effects of the same meal, up to double.
perk.feedback.slow_release.gloss: Stretches the meal's effects but holds them back longer.
perk.feedback.quickening.gloss: The meal's effects arrive sooner and end sooner, and a crash may follow.
perk.feedback.bracing.gloss: A small absorbing shield for a while, about one hit worth.
perk.feedback.mending.gloss: Heals you faster for a while, but only while you are fed.
perk.feedback.steadying.gloss: Blows push you less for a while; explosions still do. Slows you while it lasts.
perk.feedback.lightfoot.gloss: Brief speed and quicker stamina refill, at the price of hunger.
perk.feedback.bitter_tonic.gloss: Eases weakness and mining fatigue up to level I, then leaves a short slowness.
perk.feedback.brine_tolerance.gloss: Salt in the same dish protects it from spoiling longer; toxin is not helped.
perk.feedback.sleep_ward.gloss: Sets back the time since you last rested, so phantoms hold off; leaves you drowsy.
perk.feedback.breathing.gloss: Your air lasts longer underwater for a while; it is the air bar only.
perk.feedback.digestive.gloss: Fat and fibre hold the meal's effects back less, so they come sooner.
perk.feedback.hearth.gloss: A warm meal with this keeps you regenerating for longer; cold meals get nothing.
perk.feedback.keen_edge.gloss: Your blows land harder for a short while, but you are hurt more too.

modular.feedback.fig.toxin.tip: Stable toxin over the dish's whole mixture: more food dilutes it.
modular.feedback.role.enrichment.tip: Worked into the dough to make it rich: an egg, sugar or honey. Optional, and a second one makes it richer still.
modular.feedback.desc.part.dough: Dough laid in a shape before it is baked. A kneaded dough keeps its knead through the shaping.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.flat: Like a loaf, but pressed thin: it bakes quick and is called a flatbread.
modular.feedback.desc.variant.roll: Like a loaf, but pinched small: a bread roll.
modular.feedback.role.top.tip: A second pastry laid over the filling, a lid or lattice. Optional.

prep.feedback.apart.soup: A stew is a mixture: it cannot be taken apart.

screen.feedback.probe.row.kind.tip: What sort of stuff the material is.
screen.feedback.probe.row.perk.tip: Given free to a weapon part made of it.
screen.feedback.probe.row.hardness.tip: Smallest blow that works it; each blow does its strength divided by this in work.
screen.feedback.probe.row.work_min.tip: Colder than this it cannot be worked.
screen.feedback.probe.row.work_max.tip: Hotter than this it cannot be worked.
screen.feedback.probe.row.anneal.tip: Past this it forgets being worked.
screen.feedback.probe.row.service.tip: A machine body of it softens and wears above this.
screen.feedback.probe.row.burns.tip: Held in air above this it burns.
screen.feedback.probe.row.scales.tip: Held in air above this it scales.
screen.feedback.probe.row.cooling.tip: A loose piece loses this much every tick.
screen.feedback.probe.row.conductivity.t: Heat passed by a one-block wall of it.
screen.feedback.probe.row.flame.tip: Flame temperature and how long a piece burns.
screen.feedback.probe.row.freeze.tip: A bucket of the melt holds its melting point this long as it freezes.
screen.feedback.probe.row.toughness.tip: A single blow over this cracks it.
screen.feedback.probe.row.toughness_brit: Under its hardness: anything that could move it breaks it.
screen.feedback.probe.row.ductility.tip: Cold working steps before it cracks.
screen.feedback.probe.row.work_hardening: Each cold step makes it this much harder until annealed.
screen.feedback.probe.row.yield.tip: A part of it bends under this load.
screen.feedback.probe.row.friction.tip: How hard it is to slide on.
screen.feedback.probe.row.abrasiveness.t: Cutting it spends grit at this share of the worst rate.
screen.feedback.probe.row.quench.tip: Whether plunging it in water hardens it.
screen.feedback.probe.row.viscosity.tip: How thick the melt is, against water.
screen.feedback.probe.row.melt_density.t: Weight per litre of the melt.
screen.feedback.probe.row.curie.tip: Hotter than this a magnet no longer pulls it.
screen.feedback.probe.row.reflectivity.t: Share of the light on it that it throws back.
screen.feedback.probe.row.ampacity.tip: Current a wire of it carries before it melts, against copper.
screen.feedback.probe.row.drop.tip: Volts lost per block per amp.
screen.feedback.probe.row.electrode.tip: A cell makes the difference between its two electrodes.
screen.feedback.probe.row.insulation.tip: As a wire's coat it holds off up to this, then burns.
screen.feedback.probe.row.corrosion.tip: Share that water and acid leave intact.
screen.feedback.probe.row.propellant.tip: What drives the slug: a coil's field or burning powder.
screen.feedback.probe.row.burn_rate.tip: Share of a barrel's length burned per metre.
screen.feedback.probe.row.oxygen.tip: Spare oxygen can burn another fuel; short needs an oxidizer blended in.
screen.feedback.probe.row.excluded.tip: Shapes this material does not come in.

feedback.jade.icebox.hold.2: Held cold by the Refrigeration Unit
feedback.jei.info.jar: Put one jar and one food, or one ladled serving, in the crafting grid in any arrangement to fill it. Then seal it in a Pressure Vessel over a hot fire.
feedback.jei.info.jarred_food: Made by filling a jar in the crafting grid. Heat above plain boiling, which only pressure reaches, seals it and kills what is live in it. Kept hot after sealing it goes mushy. Eating it returns the jar.
feedback.jei.info.salt: Left behind when a Stockpot of sea water boils dry beside the ocean or a beach. Put one salt and one food in the crafting grid to salt the food: it keeps longer, is drier, and shrugs off more of what is live or toxic in it.
feedback.jei.info.dough: Three wheat and a water bucket. Knead it on the Prep Table, then bake it. Add an egg for pastry dough, or lay it out on the Prep Table for flatbread.
skill.feedback.figure.light_foot: Share %s of the movement-speed penalty your worn armour carries is handed back as speed
skill.feedback.figure.steady_walk: Spread that walking adds to a shot %s (fraction off)
skill.feedback.figure.footing: Crouched, a tether pulls you %s less (fraction off, more in heavy armour)
skill.feedback.figure.crank_beat: Each click on a loaded hand crank keeps it turning %s ticks longer
skill.feedback.figure.solder_braced: Soldering after lifting the iron crouched: the tip may stray %s pad pitches further before a joint bridges
skill.feedback.figure.solder_quiet: Soldering: the tip may stray %s pad pitches further before a joint bridges
skill.feedback.figure.step_hush: Your footsteps carry %s nearer to sculk sensors and wardens (fraction)
skill.feedback.figure.hand_hush: Breaking, placing, opening and pressing carry %s nearer to sculk sensors and wardens (fraction)
skill.feedback.figure.salvage_wear: Wear a part keeps when a tool is taken apart %s (fraction off)
skill.feedback.figure.charge_tamp: Power of a demolition charge you light %s (fraction)
skill.feedback.move.running_start.desc: A straight sprint builds speed, up to a quarter faster after three seconds. A hard turn or a stop lets it go.
skill.feedback.move.fleet.desc: Cast: a burst of speed for two and a half seconds, a trail of dust behind you. Sixty percent faster with no armour speed penalty; the more speed your worn armour costs, the less of the gain you keep, down to a fifth of it. Costs 20 stamina, and rearms when you land a blow.
skill.feedback.move.quick_draw.desc: Cast: the first gun in your hotbar comes up and fires on the same tick, and stays in your hand. If it cannot fire (empty, unchambered, still cycling, no gun in the hotbar) nothing is spent. The snap shot spreads wider the heavier the gun is against your own body mass, and a hot barrel adds its own bloom. Costs 20 stamina, and rearms when you land a blow.
skill.feedback.figure.fume_soften: Poison from a fume dose %s (fraction off)
skill.feedback.figure.food_soften: Hazard effects of risky food %s (fraction off)
tooltip.feedback.potion_salts: Dissolve in a water source to restore a bottle, weaker than it was
